name: Deco

identity.oneLiner: Jazz-age geometry: stepped edges, vertical emphasis, brass on lacquer.
identity.summary: Art Deco as architecture. Stepped corners, nested brass rules, lacquer and ivory surfaces, and a strict split between display lettering and readable text. Ornament is placed, not repeated.
identity.authenticityNotes: Prefer stepped geometry and metal edge over random sunbursts. Ornament is architectural, not stickered.

axes.shape: Stepped / chamfered corners; vertical emphasis; symmetric blocks
axes.surface: Lacquer panels, subtle linen/noise, high contrast fields
axes.elevation: Terraced stacks (hard steps) more than soft blur shadows
axes.ornament: Stepped corners, nested rules, a hero fan, and diamond dividers — one motif per surface
axes.typeVoice: Limelight for ceremonial titles only; Jost for sections, controls, and reading text
axes.motion: Measured, linear accents; reveal like curtains, not bouncy
axes.iconography: Geometric line icons; mirrored where possible

bands.description: Understated Deco: display/body type, hairline brass, lacquer or ivory. No fans, rules, or stepped corners.
Recognizable Deco: stepped corners, double rules, terraced brass. No sunburst, fan, or inner ceremonial frame. Aliases: default, signature.
Full architectural program when data-fidelity-band is absent or costume: hero fan and sunburst, nested frames, diamond dividers. neverDo still binds.

dialects.label: Streamline
dialects.description: Streamline Moderne: rounded chrome, horizontal speed lines, pill controls, and soft elevation. Same brass and type, without stepped corners.

neverDo: Never put Cinzel/display faces on Button or TextField labels.
Never use neon pink/cyan — Deco metal is brass/gold/silver, not synthwave.
Never scatter sunburst SVGs on every card; one architectural motif per surface max.
Never soft-blur elevation as the primary model — prefer terraced steps.
Glow never counts toward contrast; lacquer text must pass AA on fills alone.

lines: fidelity: costume default; bands whisper|standard|costume (default deprecated alias of standard)
never: neon glow, display type on controls

card.shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #F3E7C9 18%, transparent), 0 4px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-brassDeep) 48%, transparent)
card.raisedShadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #F3E7C9 22%, transparent), 0 6px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-brassDeep) 55%, transparent)
